name: MinerU Document Extractor
tagline: Convert PDF, images, and web pages to Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, or DOCX via MinerU API
description: MinerU Document Extractor converts PDFs, scanned images, Word/PowerPoint files, and web pages into structured formats using the MinerU API. Supports token-free flash extraction for quick start, precision extraction with table/formula/OCR recognition, web crawling, and batch processing.
